content: रमण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) [रमयति-रम्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Pleasing, gratifying, delightful, charming; नन्दनानि मुनीन्द्राणां रमणानि वनौकसाम् <ls>Bk. 6. 72</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 7. 12</ls>. .{@-णः@} .²1 A lover, husband; प्रायेणैते रमणविरहेष्वङ्गनानां विनोदाः <ls>Me. 89</ls>, <ls n="Me.">39</ls>; पप्रच्छ रामां रमणोऽभिलाषम् <ls>R. 14. 27</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 21</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 60</ls>. .²2 The god of love. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Aruṇa. .²4 An ass. .²5 A testicle. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Sporting. .²2 Dalliance, pastime, amorous sport. .²3 Love, sexual union. .²4 Joy or pleasure in general. .²5 The hip and the loins.
